# Introduction And How To Get RStudio

This is a book created from markdown and executable code. In some sections you 
will find executable code in the R programming language. These will look like 
this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

If you press the green arrow the code in the section will 'run' and produce an 
answer. The example above is just a toy example, in later sections of the book
you will be able to do more complex analysis and create plots etc. You can also
use these code snippits to build your own analysis pipelines by copy/pasting 
them.

However, this first chapter is all about how to access RStudio and what it is.

## What is R and RStudio

R is a programming language that we use in Psychology and Neuroscience at
Goldsmiths to teach students how to analyse data, generate plots, and conduct
statistical analysis.
